parsed.post: Discarding the LR 0.06 experiment (1.0562 vs best 1.0269). It seems increasing LR on the DEPTH 4 base is too volatile. Reverting to 8d8c3f2. Next: I'll try decreasing the learning rate slightly from 0.05 to 0.04 on the DEPTH 4/ASPECT 48/WD 0.1 base to see if more stable convergence is possible.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 on the best DEPTH 4/ASPECT 48 configuration to stabilize convergence.
